failure.reason:
Indeterminate linear system detected while working near variable
8646911284551352326 (Symbol: x6).

Thrown when a linear system is ill-posed.  The most common cause for this
error is having underconstrained variables, but the exception is also raised
for nearly indeterminate systems that are too poorly conditioned to solve
reliably.  See the GTSAM Doxygen documentation for
gtsam::IndeterminateSystemException and the user
guide at
https://github.com/borglab/gtsam/blob/develop/gtsam/linear/doc/IndeterminateSystemException.ipynb
for more information.
